# Idaho MOS Pathfinder

> A static counseling aid for exploring Idaho Army National Guard Military Occupational Specialty pathways.

## Main pages

- [Application](https://beauxsoleil.github.io/mos/): Eligibility calculator, career catalog, saved MOSs, and recruiter pathway.
- [How results work](https://beauxsoleil.github.io/mos/methodology.html): Sources, interpretation rules, privacy, and limitations.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Beauxsoleil/mos): Public page source and data documentation.

## Important limitations

- Qualification rules are modeled from the April 2025 DA PAM 611-21 Table 10-6 MOS and Line Score Wizard workbook.
- Public Idaho availability evidence is dated September 4, 2026 and does not reserve or guarantee a vacancy.
- MEPS, current Army policy, security adjudication, medical qualification, authorized vacancy systems, and recruiter review control final eligibility.
